long_biography.plain_text:
United Electronic Industries began in the bedroom of Shaun Miller’s apartment. Over three decades, he developed the company into a specialist in rugged data-acquisition, test and control systems used in aerospace, defence, energy and semiconductor applications. He later developed a St. Thomas manufacturing operation, building a local technical workforce while serving customers far beyond the islands.

Building on UEI’s Virgin Islands presence, Miller widened his local investments. He created Standard Aviation as a private-aviation terminal at Cyril E. King Airport. Conversations with pilots and crews then exposed a shortage of convenient lodging. That operational gap led Haven Development to build a Hampton by Hilton beside Havensight Mall. UEI was acquired by AMETEK in 2023, and Miller retired from the technology company the following year. His hotel and aviation businesses extend the pattern that defined his earlier career: identifying specialised infrastructure needs and building integrated services around them.
